paragraphs.text: Myra's Marvels are a group of performers who are a part of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun . Its members are Fluros , a Merfolk sea horse -rider; Hardy , an Elf strongman; Ignacio , a firebreathing Lizard ; Katerina , a Cat - and plate-spinning Human ; and Nocturno , a Vampire garlic and stake juggler.
The Marvels are the top performers in the park. They are the main draw. Anyone coming to see the circus and shows is coming to see them, and they do not disappoint.
They were originally billed as a three-ring circus. They have banded together, and now command the big top, ensuring that all contracts must be dealt with all five.
